---
name: Project-context change
about: Propose a change that must preserve explicitly approved product or architectural decisions
title: "feat(context): "
labels: []
---

## Requested outcome

Describe the feature or correction without prescribing an implementation.

## Target repository and change scope

Which project and modules should change? Identify known boundaries and cross-app dependencies.

## Approved project decisions

Link to existing approved ADRs, contracts, project rules or tests. Do not paste
secrets or sensitive customer data. **Do not invent decisions to fill this form.**

## Acceptance checks

Describe observable functional outcomes and decision-compliance tests.

## Uncertain or conflicting requirements

Identify gaps requiring a maintainer's decision before implementing.

## Non-goals

What should remain unchanged? Mention risks of unnecessary abstraction and project drift.

> IROKO issue metadata is a trigger and an input, **not proof** that an agent
> has read or obeyed project requirements. The repository policy and runtime
> checks remain independently necessary.
